reply.summary: Liarova is a gentle grey-skinned engineered watcher who listens to dozens of minds at once and weaves shared dreams over crowds to calm them. Raised in a hidden lab, it prefers guiding quarrels to ending them by force.

feats.scene: Liarova hurls a stalled delivery truck across a loading yard with a pulse of focused thought.
Liarova shrugs off a thrown crate that would have cracked a human skull.

reply.summary: Ducra is a white-haired matriarch past three millennia old who trains outcasts in a vaulted hall of learning. Her enchantments let her step out of her body, sense hidden scents, and strip power from tyrants with a single hallowed blow.

feats.scene: Ducra drives a glowing palm into a stone pillar and collapses the whole gallery roof above her.
Ducra stands unmoved as a toppling archway crashes down on her shoulders.

reply.summary: Terluore is a tubby, white-haired old gentleman who speaks one magic word and becomes a lightning-bright champion able to fly and lift trucks. He prefers shouting plans from behind the real fighters.

feats.scene: Terluore hoists a bus overhead and flings it into a monstrous crab attacking the waterfront.
Terluore laughs off a collapsing warehouse wall dropped on his back.
Terluore rockets over the harbor faster than a jet.

reply.summary: Vausau is a flustered business manager who blames an imaginary ailment whenever asked to show off powers he does not have. He survives on bluster, theatrical acting and a talent for slipping out of danger.

feats.scene: Vausau swings a rolled umbrella at a lurking thug and lands a loud, stinging thwack.
Vausau tumbles down a flight of stairs and gets up grumbling but unhurt.

reply.summary: Lorau is a bumbling elderly gadgeteer in a children's television adventure, forever tinkering with contraptions that half work. He reluctantly steps in whenever his young friends need a clever fix.

feats.scene: Lorau fires a homemade spring-launcher that knocks a cardboard villain flat across the studio.
Lorau takes a tumble from a stepladder and dusts off his knees.

reply.summary: Rinocis is a sneering career thief nicknamed for the wrench he carries and the gears he sabotages. Little is known beyond whispers of heists in a farm-country town.

feats.scene: Rinocis wrenches a vault hinge off its mount with a heavy steel bar.
Rinocis takes a crowbar blow across the ribs and keeps running.

reply.summary: Telosa is a green-eyed, wild-haired daughter of a gambling crook, fighting in a stylised cartoon-inspired world. She laughs through every scrap and leaves a trail of cards and confetti.

feats.scene: Telosa kicks a steel door off its frame during a rooftop chase.
Telosa bounces off a parked van and rolls back to her feet grinning.

reply.summary: Sesenum is a ruthless stalker of glamorous strangers, creeping through back alleys with a blade for cutting boxes. She feels little pain and hides well in shadows, and her cruelty is her only talent.

feats.scene: Sesenum drives a blade through a thick leather jacket in a single lunge.
Sesenum keeps sprinting after taking a heavy fall onto concrete.

reply.summary: Iarolent is a restless reality-hopping trickster who changes costumes and false parentage as often as she changes towns. She fights with joke weapons such as exploding powder puffs and lipstick that fires bullets.

feats.scene: Iarolent detonates a bundle of trick lipsticks and blows a hole in a brick wall.
Iarolent is flung through a shop window and rolls up laughing.

reply.summary: Llironla is a pink-haired zealot who rules a tribe of sewer dwellers and preaches that ugliness is a weapon. She scars herself on purpose and fights with brutal, unsettling glee.

feats.scene: Llironla slams a rusted pipe through a guard's shield and sends him sprawling.
Llironla tanks a point-blank shotgun blast to the shoulder and keeps smiling.

reply.summary: Llerelu is a pink-haired schoolchild with chalk-white skin, a big grin and a clownish streak, drawn in a cute cartoon style. She turns every classroom disaster into a game with face paint and pranks.

feats.scene: Llerelu flings a custard pie straight into a teacher's face from across the playground.
Llerelu tumbles off a tall slide and bounces up unbothered.

reply.summary: Valeretu is a green-haired killer from a doomed possible future, ruined by a father who would not love her. She rampages through a gloomy metropolis with bombs and a bleak sense of humour.

feats.scene: Valeretu plants a charge at the foot of a skyscraper and brings a whole corner of it down.
Valeretu drops off a rooftop, snags a ledge and swings away bruised.

reply.summary: Erneo is a towering, slow-witted giant whose overgrown frame came from a faulty gland. Clamped into a borrowed suit of armour with a flying mace, he is led around by whichever bully gives the orders.

feats.scene: Erneo swings the glowing mace through a parked bus and cleaves it in half.
Erneo walks through a wall of gunfire and a crushing truck without slowing.
Erneo hovers down a street in pursuit at the pace of a speeding car.

reply.summary: Riarno is a bald, bulky brute who bullies a river-valley city with raw muscle. His strength is great but his plans are clumsy, and swifter heroes run rings around him.

feats.scene: Riarno tears a lamp post from the pavement and bends it around a van.
Riarno stays standing after a speeding car clips him at the crossroads.

reply.summary: Iurncor is a dark-haired young thief serving a brooding armoured prince in a medieval retelling. He slips through castle windows and lifts keys, jewels and secrets without being seen.

feats.scene: Iurncor hurls a dagger across a great hall and pins a banner to the oak beam.
Iurncor drops from a battlement into a hay cart and walks away.

reply.summary: Orleseo is a scheming noble of an island kingdom who plots to seize its throne by force and fear. He rules through guards and threats rather than skill, and his schemes unravel when kindness wins the people.

feats.scene: Orleseo slashes a ceremonial sabre through a heavy curtain and a table behind it.
Orleseo is thrown to the marble floor in a scuffle and stays only dazed.

reply.summary: Ceeoia is a cheerful young crimefighter in a cartoon where cars have personalities. He swings from a grapple line, throws gadgets, and rides a sporty red machine that talks back.

feats.scene: Ceeoia launches a boomerang gadget that smashes a robber's getaway tyre and a loading dock crate.
Ceeoia is bumped by a runaway cart and shakes it off.
Ceeoia races through the tunnel on his talking ride at highway speed.

reply.summary: Ntovaaul is the lone survivor of a dying multiverse, a dark-clad hunter stalking monsters through the ruins of fallen worlds. Grief has hollowed him out, leaving only resolve and the cold of an empty sky.

feats.scene: Ntovaaul drives a blazing lance into a dragon the size of a continent and shatters its flank.
Ntovaaul stands in a wave of ruin that unmakes a whole world and walks out the other side.

reply.summary: Naaneau is a sugar-addicted teenage killer from a coastal country, famous for a rampage she began as a child. She fights dirty with little training and cannot stop herself craving sweets.

feats.scene: Naaneau jams a sharpened lollipop stick into a guard's hand and bolts for the door.
Naaneau shakes off a kick to the stomach and bites back.

reply.summary: Lltelnau is a mute winged guardian who reigns over a fiery underworld by silent decree. Immortal, strong and swift, he flies between realms carrying keys and judgments without uttering a word.

feats.scene: Lltelnau brings a closed fist down and levels a craggy mountain of black glass.
Lltelnau stands in a firestorm that scorches a whole plain and is unmarked.
Lltelnau dives down through the underworld skies far faster than sound.

reply.summary: Nauiarser is a masked agent of a poison-dealing syndicate in an island nation, once part of a rival beast-themed gang. He kills for pay and dies in the same shadowy trade.

feats.scene: Nauiarser flicks a poisoned needle that drops a sentry in the doorway.
Nauiarser shrugs off a baton strike to the back of the neck.

reply.summary: Seceo is a tiny crime boss who dresses like a stringed puppet to unnerve rivals. He hires goons to do the lifting and runs elaborate scams from a cluttered toy-themed hideout.

feats.scene: Seceo pulls a lever that drops a heavy crate onto his enemy's getaway path.
Seceo tumbles from a shelf in his lair and stays only scuffed.

reply.summary: Sernantau is a bald, round-faced thug who works alongside a lookalike relative, bickering and bragging as they rob banks. He hits hard enough to bruise but flees at the first sign of real trouble.

feats.scene: Sernantau swings a pair of cast-iron skillets and dents a teller's cage.
Sernantau falls off a building ledge and lands heavily on a awning.

reply.summary: Tiusina is a bald, brawling leader of a gang of costumed bank robbers that revives its old crew with a cousin. His crimes are loud and silly, ending in handcuffs more often than loot.

feats.scene: Tiusina shoulder-charges a bank door off its hinges.
Tiusina keeps standing after a cop swings a nightstick across his ribs.

reply.summary: Serreo is a pink-feathered, cartoon bird who captains a pleasure cruiser and is easily fooled by his clever amphibian pal. He is cheerful, loyal, and a very capable sailor.

feats.scene: Serreo hauls the wheel hard over and slams the bow into a rotted pier.
Serreo is dunked into the harbor by a rogue wave and paddles back aboard.

reply.summary: Uloraami is a hired soldier who leads raids for a shadowy group, charging in behind a wall of followers. He fails at his main mission but his troops escape with the samples they were sent for.

feats.scene: Uloraami drives a rifle butt through a crate lid in a cell block corridor.
Uloraami takes a heavy punch to the jaw and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Osaco is a tall mage from a mountain people, angry about smog and poisoned rivers. He lures a girl into a ritual to loose a stampede of spirit-beasts and a wave of flame across a crowded square.

feats.scene: Osaco channels a spell through a kidnapped girl and sets a whole plaza ablaze.
Osaco is thrown into a stone statue by a counterspell and rises with a snarl.

reply.summary: Oleam is a pale, pink-eyed assassin, the overlooked son of a ruthless immortal chieftain. Healing waters have stretched his lifespan and toughened his body, and he serves with fierce, unrewarded loyalty.

feats.scene: Oleam drives a short blade through a reinforced door in a swift double strike.
Oleam endures a fall through a glass atrium and walks off.
Oleam sprints along a rooftop at the pace of an elite runner.

reply.summary: Sonstu is a lone orange-skinned refugee who crosses the stars warning world after world of a star-devouring horror. Purple-haired and weary, she has watched billions die but never stops carrying the message.

feats.scene: Sonstu rams her failing starship into a drifting asteroid cluster and scatters it over a river valley.
Sonstu climbs out of her crashed ship unharmed.
Sonstu's ship crosses a dark gulf between suns in a few days.

reply.summary: Tonamse is a black-haired woman who spins wind into twisters and hovers on the swirling gale. She joins a crew of storm-bringers and uses her gusts for burglary and chaos.

feats.scene: Tonamse whips up a funnel that tears the roof off a warehouse.
Tonamse is slammed against a billboard by a rival's blast and drops to a crouch.
Tonamse rides her own wind down a boulevard faster than traffic.

reply.summary: Llurilro is a red-haired, pipe-smoking sailor of the old wooden-ship days who turns to flying bombers when war arrives. He is brave, cheerful and sure-handed at the helm of any craft.

feats.scene: Llurilro hoists a harpoon and drives it deep through a hull plank.
Llurilro survives a plunge from the rigging onto the deck.

reply.summary: Asiiarn is a hunchbacked saboteur who leads a tiny cell of wartime agents bent on wrecking a plane factory. He boasts of his great brain and is gunned down by one of his own bumbling men.

feats.scene: Asiiarn sets a satchel charge that blows a hole in the factory floor.
Asiiarn is shot by a stray bullet and collapses.

reply.summary: Esveotum is a steady, bald harbor-town patrolman, engaged to a fellow officer. He walks his beat, breaks up brawls on the docks, and does his job without fuss.

feats.scene: Esveotum tackles a fleeing pickpocket onto the quay planks.
Esveotum takes a bottle to the shoulder during a dockside brawl and arrests the thrower.

reply.summary: Varesleo is a fair-haired artisan from a shrunken-city people, trained as an engineer and gifted with the strength and flight of his kind under a yellow sun. He sculpts for his guild and rebuilds machines in his spare time.

feats.scene: Varesleo lifts a toppled girder and tosses it clear of a collapsing tower.
Varesleo is buried by falling masonry and climbs out without a scratch.
Varesleo streaks over the skyline at the speed of sound.

reply.summary: Serllelu is a hero-shaped weapon: a muscle-bound patriot's body secretly driven by a tyrant's stolen mind. Built to be a poster-boy for a rigged campaign, he hides cruel ambitions behind a flag and a grin.

feats.scene: Serllelu pummels an armoured car into a crumpled heap with his bare fists.
Serllelu takes a rifle volley square in the chest and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Varevor is a heavy-fisted enforcer for a street gang that harasses an archer vigilante. He drives a hard bargain with his knuckles and has no patience for strategy.

feats.scene: Varevor punches through a brick wall to snatch a fleeing rival.
Varevor walks away from a head-on crash with a stolen van.

reply.summary: Stiel is a veteran fighter rejuvenated for one last rebellion, able to blow up any part of his body with a thunderous blast and knit himself back together moments later. He is eventually triggered into a final, city-wide detonation.

feats.scene: Stiel's final blast sets off a chain reaction that flattens an entire capital's downtown.
Stiel's arm detonates, shreds a bunker door, and re-forms in a flash of dust.

reply.summary: Tausimi is a blue-skinned, one-limbed ring-bearer from a far-off peacekeeping force who bends stubborn will into glowing constructs. A battered lantern recharges the ring and keeps him aloft.

feats.scene: Tausimi shapes a giant emerald hammer and flattens a row of enemy bunkers.
Tausimi raises a shimmering barrier that absorbs a full cannon salvo.
Tausimi streaks between moons in the time it takes to cross a town.

reply.summary: Iusuvor is a tiny, black-eyed imp from a flat, colourful dimension who adores a masked acrobat and sincerely wants to help. He can warp reality, change shape, teleport and fly around his idol's rooftop adventures.

feats.scene: Iusuvor snaps his fingers and turns a runaway truck into a harmless pile of balloons.
Iusuvor bounces off a falling lamp post and giggles.

reply.summary: Teroas is a hapless colonial lad whose strange gift cracks and splinters whatever stands near him. Applicants like him are turned away because a handshake with him spells ruin for friends and foes alike.

feats.scene: Teroas touches a bridge rail and a fracture races down the whole span until it crumbles.
Teroas trips over his own shoelaces and skids across a pavement.

reply.summary: Iumsa is an ordinary city dweller handed unexpected abilities by a billionaire's scheme and who takes up a costume to guard the streets. A dark-haired volunteer, he fights bravely in a clash that costs many lives.

feats.scene: Iumsa leaps and lands a heavy blow that dents a metal shutter.
Iumsa shrugs off a flying chunk of concrete in the melee.

reply.summary: Illser is a loyal bald eagle, kept as a pet and best friend by a gruff masked vigilante. He glides above rooftops, grabs foes with his talons and refuses to be house-trained.

feats.scene: Illser dives and rakes his talons across a gunman's gun hand.
Illser tumbles through a hedge after a collision and hops up squawking.
Illser stoops on a fleeing rabbit at the speed of a diving raptor.

reply.summary: Riaeorli is a brown-feathered pet eagle with yellow eyes who patrols the skies for his owner, a boastful soldier of fortune. His talons and wings are his only weapons.

feats.scene: Riaeorli swoops low and snatches a radio from a lookout's hand.
Riaeorli takes a clip from a branch and recovers mid-air.
Riaeorli banks over a canyon rim at full speed.

reply.summary: Oramoan is a bald, sickly pirate who sails the underground tunnels of a great city with iron hooks in place of hands. Bathing near a glowing relic poisoned his body, and he is wasting away between drinks.

feats.scene: Oramoan swings both hooks and rips a turnstile bar loose.
Oramoan keeps standing after a hard shove into a tiled platform wall.

reply.summary: Tiuvalan is a grey-haired crime lord who collects secrets by listening through walls and keyholes. He is taken down in a single outing by a feathered hero.

feats.scene: Tiuvalan hurls a heavy ashtray at a window and shatters it.
Tiuvalan takes a shove against a desk and wheezes.

reply.summary: Aulesinil is a dark-haired freelance reporter chasing a string of grisly murders through a large coastal city. He suspects a ghostly avenger but never pins down the truth behind it.

feats.scene: Aulesinil shoves a stuck newsroom door open with his shoulder.
Aulesinil is knocked flat by a thug's punch and gets back up with notebook in hand.

reply.summary: Raseveo is a dark-haired city preacher who campaigns against street drugs, angering a local mobster. Threatened again and again, he hires a lookalike stand-in to protect his wife and young son.

feats.scene: Raseveo slams a hand on the pulpit and the whole congregation falls silent.
Raseveo endures a shove from a gang enforcer on the church steps.

reply.summary: Eoialnu is a wealthy rancher who finds a trinket in a souvenir stall and becomes convinced he is the creator of everything. While it lasts he can heal wounds, then wakes with no memory when the trinket is removed.

feats.scene: Eoialnu waves a hand over a bleeding patient and the wound closes at once.
Eoialnu takes a punch in the face and merely blinks.

reply.summary: Telliu is a brown-haired racketeer who runs a blackmail ring in a capital city, using a seductive informant to coax secrets out of officers. His gang is rounded up by a band of university girls and a masked heroine.

feats.scene: Telliu pounds a desk and sends a typewriter crashing to the floor.
Telliu goes down under a pile of cheering students and is cuffed.

reply.summary: Miauau is a small world conjured inside a newborn cosmos to test whether a people could flourish without a caped champion. Its history runs in a hyper-fast blur, ending with the people inventing their own legends.

feats.scene: Miauau endures the furious heat of its own sun-driven birth and a whole civilisation's rise within one blink.
